subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers has Kishanganga river as one of its major tributaries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jhelum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kishanganga** is a tributary of **Jhelum.**
 
• The Kishanganga River is called **Neelam in Pakistan.**
 
• Kishanganga River Valley project is located in the union territory of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• The Kishanganga Hydroelectric plant diverts water from the Kishanganga River to a power plant in the Jhelum River.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, and Sutlej** are the major tributaries of the **Indus River.**
 
• Indus is one of Asia's longest rivers. 
 
• It flows through the Indian state of Jammu & Kashmir, China, and Pakistan.
 
• River Indus originates in Tibet in Mount Kailash near lake Mansarovar Lake.
 
• It drains into the Arabian Sea.
 
• The total length of the river is 3,180 kilometres.
 
• The correct sequence of tributaries from north to south is Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, and Sutlej.
